name: caviar_stop_resume
author: CAVIAR project (EC IST 2001 37540)
title: OneStopNoEnter1front
license: CC BY-SA (version unspecified by the official source)
changes: All 725 official JPEG-sequence frames retained at 384x288, converted via OpenCV MP4V to silent H.264/yuv420p CFR MP4 at the official 25 FPS. Output adds same-frame full/objects/none comparison, titles and a capture-status footer; sidebars are cropped from the comparison.
purpose: Fixed-camera functional demo with walking, stopping and resumed movement. No independent accuracy score is provided.

name: dog_walker_tokyo
author: Nesnad
title: Pro dog walker - Tokyo - 2024 Nov 1.webm
changes: All 271 decoded original WebM frames retained at 1920x1080, audio removed, directly transcoded to H.264/yuv420p CFR MP4 at reported 30 FPS. Output is resized for analysis to 960x540 and adds object detection/track boxes in objects display mode plus a status sidebar (1340x540).
purpose: Person/dog selection and tracking smoke test. Camera movement and occlusion mean this is not a fixed-camera MOG2 accuracy benchmark.
